purpose: Per CEO R282 P0: 'The primary endpoint must be pre-registered. The exact threshold should be frozen BEFORE running the expanded matrix.' This document is written and committed BEFORE any 5-seed runs are executed.
constitutional_basis: Article XXVII (no threshold invention — thresholds must have provenance, not be invented after seeing results). Article XXX (never optimize the evaluator — cannot adjust the bar to make V2 pass). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — cannot redefine success after the fact).

primary_endpoint.name: time_to_critical_failure_under_sensor_noise
primary_endpoint.definition: Mean time-to-critical-failure (hours) across 5 seeds under the noise_3x attack mode
primary_endpoint.rationale: Sensor noise is the most realistic operating condition for an implanted device. Time-to-critical-failure is the clinically meaningful outcome (how long until the patient needs emergency intervention).

frozen_success_criterion.rule: V2 must outperform B (existing predictive closed-loop) on the primary endpoint across the MAJORITY of seeds, with NO catastrophic regression outside the predefined failure envelope.

quantified_thresholds.primary_threshold: V2 mean t_fail under noise_3x >= 2.0x B mean t_fail under noise_3x (across 5 seeds). R281 1-seed showed 4.3x. Threshold 2.0x is conservative — allows V2 to degrade by >50% from 1-seed performance and still pass.
quantified_thresholds.majority_of_seeds: V2 t_fail > B t_fail in >= 4 of 5 seeds under noise_3x. (4/5 = 80%, well above chance.)
quantified_thresholds.no_catastrophic_regression: V2 must NOT have peak ICP > 40 mmHg under noise_3x in any seed. (40 mmHg = 2x the 20 mmHg hard limit. R281 showed 19.8 mmHg. If any seed shows >40 mmHg, that is a catastrophic regression even if the mean passes.)
quantified_thresholds.secondary_endpoints_check: V2 must outperform B on >= 4 of 6 secondary endpoints under noise_3x (mean across 5 seeds).

frozen_success_criterion.what_passes: ALL THREE conditions met: (1) V2/B ratio >= 2.0x on primary, (2) V2 > B in >= 4/5 seeds, (3) no V2 seed with peak > 40 mmHg, AND (4) V2 wins >= 4/6 secondary endpoints.
frozen_success_criterion.what_fails: ANY of: (1) V2/B ratio < 2.0x, (2) V2 > B in < 4/5 seeds, (3) any V2 seed with peak > 40 mmHg, OR (4) V2 wins < 4/6 secondary endpoints.
frozen_success_criterion.what_happens_on_pass: Proceed to physical bench validation. Send V2 materials + PHYSICAL_BENCH_PACKAGE.json to Miethke. The 5-seed result becomes the first statistical evidence in the package.
frozen_success_criterion.what_happens_on_fail: P-01 V2 does NOT proceed to bench validation. The failure mode is documented. Options: (a) revise V2 parameters (NOT the mechanism — CEO directive: do not modify V2 mechanism), (b) close P-01. The decision is deferred to CEO.

ablation_success_criterion.rule: Determine the SMALLEST mechanism that preserves the benefit.
ablation_success_criterion.method: For each ablation arm (V2_no_rate_limit, V2_no_hysteresis, V2_no_drainage_floor, V2_no_alpha_floor), compare to full V2 across 5 seeds × 9 attacks.
ablation_success_criterion.threshold: An ablation arm is 'non-critical' if its mean t_fail across 5 seeds × 9 attacks is >= 80% of full V2's mean t_fail. An ablation arm is 'critical' if its mean t_fail is < 80% of full V2.
ablation_success_criterion.what_we_expect_based_on_R281_1seed: Rate limiting will be critical (< 80% of V2). Hysteresis, drainage floor, alpha floor will be non-critical (>= 80% of V2). BUT: this is a HYPOTHESIS based on 1 seed × 2 attacks. The 5-seed × 9-attack ablation may reveal different results under different attack modes.
ablation_success_criterion.what_we_do_NOT_do: We do NOT pre-decide which mechanism is critical. The ablation data determines it. If all 4 mechanisms turn out to be critical under some attacks, V2 stays as a 4-feature system. If only rate limiting is critical across all 9 attacks, the commercial package becomes 'rate-limited conductance control' (1 feature).

anti_gaming_rules: This document is committed BEFORE any 5-seed runs. Git timestamp verifies this.

The thresholds are chosen based on R281 1-seed results, but with CONSERVATIVE margins (2.0x ratio vs R281's 4.3x; 40 mmHg ceiling vs R281's 19.8 mmHg). This allows V2 to degrade significantly and still pass — it is not a rubber stamp.
If V2 fails, I will NOT adjust the thresholds. I will report the failure honestly and defer to CEO.
If V2 passes on a technicality (e.g., ratio 2.01x), I will note the margin and recommend bench validation with caution.
The ablation 'critical' threshold (80%) is arbitrary but pre-registered. It cannot be changed after seeing results.
